verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is an AI chat platform that can bring the user's own data into the model. Its documented RAG pulls relevant content from uploaded sources into chat responses, Python can run on data, CSVs and Office files can be previewed, and scheduled prompts like 'summarize new files every Monday' produce recurring insights. Two community users report RAG not working on CPU-only or external-API setups, a real but configuration-specific caveat. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that data analysis works well, evidence of proactive suggestions not prompted by the user, and documented reliability of RAG without a GPU.
